name: Smilers
description: Luminous teeth floating in darkness. Highly dangerous. Avoid light sources in dark areas.

name: Facelings
description: Humanoid beings without faces. Most are harmless, some are hostile. Come in adult and child forms.

name: Hounds
description: Dog-like creatures that can be befriended with food. Generally not hostile unless provoked.

name: Skin-Stealers
description: Humanoid creatures that can disguise themselves by wearing the skin of their victims.

name: Deathmoths
description: Large moth-like creatures. Females are aggressive and carnivorous.

name: Mannequins
description: Animate mannequins that move when not observed. Generally hostile.

name: Clumps
description: Amalgamations of human body parts fused together. Extremely dangerous.

name: Dullers
description: Grey humanoid creatures that avoid contact. Low threat.
